title: "RAG Baseline (Config A)"
execute:
  eval: false

This chapter implements the baseline RAG pipeline using dense retrieval only, without any knowledge graph integration. It serves as the reference configuration for comparison in Chapter 06.

## Setup

```{python}
#| label: imports
#| code-summary: "Show imports"

import os
import json
import pickle
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from tqdm import tqdm

# LangChain
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI, OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbeddings
from langchain_text_splitters import RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
from langchain_chroma import Chroma
from langchain_core.documents import Document
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableParallel, RunnablePassthrough

# ChromaDB
import chromadb

load_dotenv()
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths - analog zu Stage 1/2
REPO_ROOT = Path.cwd() if (Path.cwd() / "data").exists() else Path.cwd().parents[1]
STAGE1_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed"
STAGE3_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed" / "stage3"
STAGE3_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

## Data Loading & Joining

```{python}
#| label: data-loading
#| code-summary: "Load and join Stage 1 data"

# Load cleaned chunks from Stage 1
chunks_df = pd.read_csv(STAGE1_DIR / "media_has_chunk_cleaned.csv")
print(f"Chunks: {len(chunks_df):,}")

# Load cleaned media from Stage 1 (for metadata: title, url, domain)
media_df = pd.read_csv(STAGE1_DIR / "media_cleaned.csv",
                       usecols=["media_id", "title", "url", "domain"])
print(f"Articles: {len(media_df):,}")

# Join metadata onto chunks
chunks_df = chunks_df.merge(media_df, on="media_id", how="left")

# Generate chunk_id
chunks_df = chunks_df.reset_index(drop=True)
chunks_df["chunk_id"] = chunks_df.index

print(f"\nColumns: {chunks_df.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Missing metadata: {chunks_df['title'].isna().sum()}")
chunks_df.head(3)
```

## Chunking

```{python}
#| label: chunking
#| code-summary: "Split oversized chunks"

splitter = RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(
    chunk_size=1024,
    chunk_overlap=128,
    separators=["\n\n", "\n", "(?<=\. )", " ", ""],
    length_function=len,
)

# Check distribution before
print("Before splitting:")
print(f"  Chunks > 1024 chars: {(chunks_df['chunked_content'].str.len() > 1024).sum():,}")
print(f"  Chunks > 2048 chars: {(chunks_df['chunked_content'].str.len() > 2048).sum():,}")

# Split oversized chunks into LangChain Documents
documents = []
for _, row in tqdm(chunks_df.iterrows(), total=len(chunks_df)):
    text = str(row["chunked_content"])
    metadata = {
        "chunk_id":  int(row["chunk_id"]),
        "media_id":  int(row["media_id"]),
        "title":     str(row["title"]),
        "url":       str(row["url"]),
        "domain":    str(row["domain"]),
        "sentiment": str(row["sentiment"]),
    }
    if len(text) > 1024:
        sub_chunks = splitter.split_text(text)
        for i, sub in enumerate(sub_chunks):
            sub_meta = {**metadata, "sub_chunk": i}
            documents.append(Document(page_content=sub, metadata=sub_meta))
    else:
        documents.append(Document(page_content=text, metadata=metadata))

print(f"\nAfter splitting:")
print(f"  Total documents: {len(documents):,}")
```

```{python}
#| label: save chunks
#| code-summary: "Save chunked documents for later use"

import pickle
DOCS_PATH = STAGE3_DIR / "chunks_minilm.pkl"
with open(DOCS_PATH, "wb") as f:
    pickle.dump(documents, f)
print(f"Saved {len(documents):,} documents")
```

```{python}
#| label: chunks-inspection
#| code-summary: "Load and inspect split chunks"
#| eval: true

DOCS_PATH = STAGE3_DIR / "chunks_minilm.pkl"

# Load from disk
with open(DOCS_PATH, "rb") as f:
    documents = pickle.load(f)
print(f"Loaded {len(documents):,} documents")

# Find examples that were split (have sub_chunk key)
split_examples = [(i, doc) for i, doc in enumerate(documents)
                  if doc.metadata.get("sub_chunk", -1) > 0]
print(f"Sub-chunks created: {len(split_examples):,}")

# Show first example with its predecessor
idx, example = split_examples[0]
prev = documents[idx - 1]

print("\n=== Sub-chunk 0 ===")
print(f"Titel:  {prev.metadata['title']}")
print(f"Länge:  {len(prev.page_content)} Zeichen")
print(prev.page_content[:300])

print("\n=== Sub-chunk 1 (overlap sichtbar) ===")
print(f"Länge:  {len(example.page_content)} Zeichen")
print(example.page_content[:300])

print("\n→ Overlap:")
print(f"Ende von Sub-chunk 0: ...{prev.page_content[-128:]}")
print(f"Anfang von Sub-chunk 1: {example.page_content[:128]}...")
```

## Embeddings

```{python}
#| label: embeddings
#| code-summary: "Generate embeddings with checkpointing"

EMBEDDINGS_PATH = STAGE3_DIR / "embeddings_minilm.npy"
DOCS_PATH = STAGE3_DIR / "chunks_minilm.pkl"

embedding_model = HuggingFaceEmbeddings(
    model_name="sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
    model_kwargs={"device": "cpu"},
)

if EMBEDDINGS_PATH.exists() and DOCS_PATH.exists():
    print("Loading embeddings from checkpoint...")
    embeddings = np.load(EMBEDDINGS_PATH)
    with open(DOCS_PATH, "rb") as f:
        documents = pickle.load(f)
    print(f"Loaded {len(embeddings):,} embeddings")
else:
    print("Generating embeddings (this will take a while)...")
    embeddings = []
    BATCH_SIZE = 256

    for i in tqdm(range(0, len(documents), BATCH_SIZE)):
        batch = documents[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        texts = [doc.page_content for doc in batch]
        batch_embeddings = embedding_model.embed_documents(texts)
        embeddings.extend(batch_embeddings)

        # Checkpoint every 10'000 documents
        if (i // BATCH_SIZE) % (10_000 // BATCH_SIZE) == 0 and i > 0:
            np.save(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, np.array(embeddings))
            print(f"  Checkpoint saved at {i:,}")

    embeddings = np.array(embeddings)
    np.save(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, embeddings)
    with open(DOCS_PATH, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(documents, f)
    print(f"\nSaved {len(embeddings):,} embeddings to {EMBEDDINGS_PATH}")
```

## ChromaDB Indexing

```{python}
#| label: chromadb-indexing
#| eval: false
#| code-summary: "Store embeddings in ChromaDB"

# Load from disk if not in memory
DOCS_PATH       = STAGE3_DIR / "chunks_minilm.pkl"
EMBEDDINGS_PATH = STAGE3_DIR / "embeddings_minilm.npy"

if "documents" not in dir():
    with open(DOCS_PATH, "rb") as f:
        documents = pickle.load(f)
    embeddings = np.load(EMBEDDINGS_PATH)
    print(f"Loaded {len(documents):,} documents and {len(embeddings):,} embeddings")

CHROMADB_PATH = STAGE3_DIR / "chromadb"
CHROMADB_PATH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

chroma_client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(CHROMADB_PATH))

collection = chroma_client.get_or_create_collection(
    name="rag_baseline",
    metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"},
)

if collection.count() == 0:
    print("Filling ChromaDB...")
    BATCH_SIZE = 512
    for i in tqdm(range(0, len(documents), BATCH_SIZE)):
        batch_docs = documents[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        batch_embs = embeddings[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        collection.add(
            documents=[doc.page_content for doc in batch_docs],
            embeddings=batch_embs.tolist(),
            ids=[str(i + j) for j in range(len(batch_docs))],
            metadatas=[doc.metadata for doc in batch_docs],
        )
    print(f"ChromaDB filled: {collection.count():,} documents")
else:
    print(f"ChromaDB already exists: {collection.count():,} documents")
```

## RAG Pipeline

```{python}
#| label: rag-pipeline
#| eval: true
#| code-summary: "Build RAG pipeline (cf. Cleantech RAG tutorial)"

# LLM
llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o", temperature=0)

# Prompt template - analog tutorial
template = template = """You are an assistant for question-answering tasks about AI trends.
Use the following retrieved context to answer the question.
Base your answer strictly on the provided context. 
If the context contains relevant information, use it even if it is partial.
Keep the answer concise but informative.

Question: {question}

Context: {context}

Answer:
"""
rag_prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template(template)

# Retriever from ChromaDB
store = Chroma(
    client=chroma_client,
    collection_name="rag_baseline",
    embedding_function=embedding_model,
)
retriever = store.as_retriever(
    search_type="similarity",
    search_kwargs={"k": 6},
)

# RAG chain - analog tutorial
def format_docs(docs):
    return "\n\n".join(doc.page_content for doc in docs)

rag_chain = RunnableParallel(
    {
        "context": retriever,
        "question": RunnablePassthrough()
    }
).assign(answer=(
    RunnablePassthrough.assign(context=(lambda x: format_docs(x["context"])))
    | rag_prompt
    | llm
    | StrOutputParser()
))

print("RAG pipeline ready.")
```

## Example Queries

```{python}
#| label: example-query-1
#| eval: true
#| code-summary: "Example queries against RAG baseline"

result = rag_chain.invoke("What are the main trends in generative AI in 2025?")

print("Question:", result["question"])
print("\nAnswer:", result["answer"])
print("\nSources:")
for doc in result["context"]:
    print(f"  - {doc.metadata['title']} ({doc.metadata['domain']})")
```
